overall_notes: This paper focuses on knowledge graph verbalization (data-to-text generation) and evaluates the generated outputs primarily through human evaluation. The paper explicitly mentions that automatic metrics cannot be used due to lack of gold references. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and removal of redundant/repetitive entries.
